mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing estradiol metabolism and increasing estradiol levels; estradiol may prolong QT interval and enhance amiodarone's antiarrhythmic effects, increasing arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor for increased estrogen-related adverse effects and QT prolongation; consider alternative contraception or dose adjustment; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
